description_en: Updates the face synchronization relationship between a user group and a device group
description_zh: 调用该接口，更新用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual update-face-user-group-and-device-group-relation --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --control-id qcb2yea4ha4d0000 --relation SYNC_INFO_PICTURE --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation

parameters.description_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications within the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** that you specified when you called the [AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~) operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group.
parameters.description_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用[AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~)接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致。
parameters.help_en: The business isolation ID, which is used to isolate data between different business applications within the same Alibaba Cloud account. Set this parameter to the same value as the **IsolationId** that you specified when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
parameters.help_zh: 业务隔离ID，用于隔离同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据。请与调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时设置的**IsolationId**保持一致
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.description_en: The control ID of the synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group. Set this parameter to the **ControlId** value that you obtained and saved locally when you called the [AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~) operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group.
parameters.description_zh: 用户组与设备组同步关系控制ID。请传入调用[AddFaceUserGroupAndDeviceGroupRelation](~~288342~~)接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时，获取并保存到本地的**ControlId**值。
parameters.help_en: The control ID of the synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group. Set this parameter to the **ControlId** value that you obtained and saved locally when you called the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html operation to add the face synchronization relationship between the user group and the device group
parameters.help_zh: 用户组与设备组同步关系控制ID。请传入调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/288342.html接口，添加用户组与设备组之间的人脸同步关系时，获取并保存到本地的**ControlId**值
parameters.name: control_id

parameters.description_en: The face synchronization relationship. Currently, only **SYNC_INFO_PICTURE** is supported, which indicates that user photos and user information are synchronized.
parameters.description_zh: 人脸同步关系。当前仅支持设置为**SYNC_INFO_PICTURE**，表示同步用户照片和用户信息。
parameters.help_en: The face synchronization relationship. Currently, only **SYNC_INFO_PICTURE** is supported, which indicates that user photos and user information are synchronized
parameters.help_zh: 人脸同步关系。当前仅支持设置为**SYNC_INFO_PICTURE**，表示同步用户照片和用户信息
